comment: The skills this site packages. They live in the algolia/skills submodule at vendor/algolia-skills; that repo is the canonical home. TEMPORARY: the submodule is pinned to the chore/ui-library-currency commit (algolia/skills#34) rather than main, because the UI-library corrections in the shipped ZIPs are not on main yet. Once #34 merges, run `npm run skills:update` to move it back to main, then `npm run release:prepare` and commit.
